title: A small dream, grown one order at a time.
text:
Revasser is a small business from Dhaka with a simple wish: to see a little dream grow, one order at a time.

What started with jewellery now reaches into original Pakistani fashion, brought to Bangladesh on pre-order. Beyond shopping, we want it to feel like an experience.
photoDescription: A wine-coloured Revasser envelope with a card reading Introducing a new chapter
